# portainer-stack

Ansible-based provisioning for a self-hosted container hosting environment on a VPS.
Installs Docker CE + Portainer CE, with optional Cloudflare Tunnel support.
Designed for hobby projects that want Git-based / GitHub Actions-based deployments without cloud cost overruns.

## Repository Structure

```
.devcontainer/            # Dev Container configuration
ansible/
  site.yaml               # Top-level playbook (imports setup.yml)
  inventory/
    hosts.ini             # Auto-generated by setup_ansible.sh — do not edit
    group_vars/
      servers.yaml        # Group variables (ansible_python_interpreter, etc.)
  playbooks/
    setup.yml             # Playbook: Docker + Portainer, optional cloudflared
  roles/
    docker/               # Install Docker CE + Compose plugin
    portainer/            # Deploy Portainer CE as a Docker container
    cloudflared/          # Install cloudflared systemd service (optional)
  vault/
    secrets.yml.example   # Ansible Vault template
tool/
  setup_env.sh            # Interactive .env generator (also applies security settings)
  setup_ansible.sh        # Load .env and run ansible-playbook
  ssh.sh                  # SSH connection wrapper
  rsync.sh                # rsync wrapper with Cloudflare Tunnel support
  sftp.sh                 # SFTP wrapper with Cloudflare Tunnel support
Makefile                  # User-facing commands
.env.example              # Template for .env
```

## .env Variables

| Variable          | Required | Description                                              |
|-------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `HOST`            | ✅       | Remote VPS IP address or hostname                        |
| `USER`            | ✅       | SSH login username                                       |
| `PORT`            | ✅       | SSH port (default: 22)                                   |
| `KEY`             | ✅       | Path to SSH private key inside the container             |
| `SUDO_PASS`       | ✅       | sudo password for Ansible privilege escalation           |
| `ENABLE_TUNNEL`   | ✅       | `true` to route all connections through Cloudflare Tunnel |
| `SUBDOMAIN`       | tunnel   | Cloudflare Tunnel subdomain                              |
| `DOMAIN`          | tunnel   | Cloudflare Tunnel domain                                 |
| `CF_TUNNEL_TOKEN` | tunnel   | Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnel token                       |

`ENABLE_TUNNEL=true` controls **both** SSH/rsync/sftp tunnel routing **and** `cloudflared` provisioning on the VPS via Ansible.

## Available Commands

| Command                  | Description                                      |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `make setup`             | Generate `.env` interactively                    |
| `make setup-ansible`     | Generate inventory and run `ansible-playbook`    |
| `make ssh`               | SSH into the remote VPS                          |
| `make rsync ARGS="..."`  | Transfer files via rsync                         |
| `make sftp ARGS="..."`   | Open interactive SFTP session                    |

## What the Playbook Does

`ansible/playbooks/setup.yml` targets Debian/Ubuntu and:
1. Asserts OS family is Debian.
2. Runs `docker` role — installs Docker CE + Compose plugin via official apt repo.
3. Runs `portainer` role — deploys `portainer/portainer-ce:latest` as a Docker container.
4. If `enable_cloudflare_tunnel=true` (derived from `ENABLE_TUNNEL`): runs `cloudflared` role — downloads and registers cloudflared as a systemd service.

After provisioning, Portainer is accessible at `https://<HOST>:9443`.

## Application Traffic Routing

Portainer itself runs on port 9443. For **stacks deployed via Portainer**, routing depends on your setup:

| Approach | Reverse proxy needed? |
|---|---|
| Cloudflare Tunnel (Public Hostname per app) | No — Cloudflare routes directly to the container |
| No Cloudflare Public Hostname | Yes — run Nginx / Traefik / Caddy on the VPS |

## GitHub Actions Deployment

Uses [carlrygart/portainer-stack-deploy](https://github.com/carlrygart/portainer-stack-deploy):

```yaml
- uses: carlrygart/portainer-stack-deploy@v1
  with:
    portainer-host: ${{ secrets.PORTAINER_HOST }}
    username: ${{ secrets.PORTAINER_USERNAME }}
    password: ${{ secrets.PORTAINER_PASSWORD }}
    stack-name: 'my-app'
    stack-definition: 'docker-compose.yml'
    image: ${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE_URI }}:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
```

## Security Settings (applied by `make setup`)

`make setup` prompts to apply the following to prevent AI tools from reading credentials in `.env`:

- **`.vscode/settings.json`**: adds `github.copilot.enable: false` and `chat.disableAIFeatures: true`
- **Deletes**: `.github/agents/` and `.github/skills/portainer-stack/SKILL.md`

## Ansible Vault

```shell
ansible-vault create ansible/vault/secrets.yml
make setup-ansible ARGS="--ask-vault-pass"
make setup-ansible ARGS="--vault-password-file /path/to/.vault_pass"
```
